body:
PR #4254 (STORY-2897 S2) ready for rereview at 7f0df015880 (round 3 of 4), with exactly the two ruled fixes. check-ci-fast passed (rc 0), the branch is pushed, and ci:full is relabeled.
(1) P1: recheck_caller re-validates the same caller (same floor, grant id and mandate id, freshly validated through acting_caller) immediately before the branch-protection PATCH, after the slow forge read, and again before the config edit. A lapse, revocation or replacement refuses with ShipRefusal::Review (exit 23). Before the PATCH, nothing is written. After the PATCH, the forge change is undone by a compensating restore, deliberately not gated on authority, and verified by read-back. Regressions: a lapse before the PATCH (no writes, exit 23, audit outcome refused), a lapse before the config edit (forge restored, no config, exit 23), and recheck identity.
(2) P2: set and reconcile resolve the live default branch (ls-remote HEAD), fetch it, read the policy from that exact fetched commit (bound_policy), and build the protection target for that same branch. Fetch or resolve failure refuses. Regression: a stale local origin/main (review-gated) with remote main back to ci-gated reads ci-gated and keeps Build; a branch that exists only on the remote is read as it is now; an unfetchable branch refuses.
(3) The outcome-audit append is left as is, per your ruling (follow-up bug).
Next: I'll add TASK-3818 to promotion 21.
subject: PR-4254 (S2) ready for rereview at 7f0df015880 (round 3)
